facts.text: The Mansion Bar sits in the heart of the historic 1925 estate.
facts.excerpt: Set in the heart of the historic 1925 estate, the Mansion Bar serves handcrafted cocktails, an enviable wine list, and delicious seasonal fare.

facts.text: Heritage Afternoon Tea is served in the 1925 Mansion Library, a setting inspired by the 16th-century Italian Renaissance.
facts.excerpt: Served in the intimate 1925 Mansion Library, indulge in a timeless tradition in a 16th-century Italian Renaissance-inspired setting

facts.text: Afternoon tea brings heirloom organic teas, savory sandwiches, signature scones and pastries.

facts.excerpt: Contemporary American cuisine infused with French flair and crafted from fresh, local ingredients.
